pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Noon in the hills of Samaria, harsh bright sun and short shadows, a dry stony landscape with a few olive trees. An old stone well with a low round wall. Jesus, a man in a plain off-white robe with a soft brown mantle, shown ONLY from behind or as a far figure, his face never visible, sits on the edge of the well with his back to the viewer, tired from the road, his dusty sandals and walking staff beside him. Heat and stillness.
